acceptance.assertion: The discovery panel is bounded to approximately 56rem on wide screens, presents purpose and location as clear cards, keeps location full-width, collapses to one column on narrow screens and is not widened again by the iPad-specific stylesheet.

Advanced access, language, freshness and curation filters are placed in a keyboard-accessible native disclosure that is closed by default; active-filter chips keep hidden selections visible and removable.
German and English copy states that multiple required-presence selections use AND semantics, and the runtime filter behavior exactly matches that statement.

Country and proximity scopes cannot remain active simultaneously: choosing a country clears nearby origin and radius, while choosing a place or current location clears country; radius remains disabled until a proximity origin exists.
The automatic sort is labeled Empfohlen or Recommended and its explanation reflects the actual active context: text relevance, spatial proximity or stable catalogue order.
Canonical renderer output, index.html, de.html, shared CSS, iPad CSS and runtime assets agree exactly in German and English with content-version references refreshed.

The clean checkpoint commit 3c2f38d on feat/filter-layout-semantics-v1 is rebased or replayed onto the post-T031 Commonworld main without losing its source-level renderer and CSS tests; no WIP commit remains in the published PR history.

The exact published head passes source and validator tests, JavaScript tests, responsive browser smoke including iPad landscape, diff-bound self-review and all required GitHub checks; a full diff download is produced before merge.
